scope: Branch-only architecture and ordered execution backlog; no new MA IDs

core_invariant.physical_object: one principally learned tensor/vector S, with m independently trainable scalar entries
core_invariant.address: paid Mirror View code per role, head and recurrence depth

scales.precision: numeric bits per scalar; separate research axis

core_invariant.execution: on-demand virtual operators, no mandatory full virtual weight materialization; no free K-fold attention compute
core_invariant.cache: canonical cache only under common-producer compatible right-transform proof

tasks.title: Minimal core and role/mask validity
tasks.gate: No invalid cache alias, no causal leak, nonzero cross-memory dependence, finite gradients; strict FP32 error <=2e-6 on exact algebra tests

tasks.title: Train useful parallel roles with shared S
tasks.gate: predeclared paired quality win on >=2 of >=3 frozen independent worlds x2 seeds and no collapsed role, else report null or fail

tasks.title: Independent m/K/R scaling and matched budgets
tasks.gate: no adoption on aligned-only or weaker-than-simple-control outcomes

tasks.title: Joint encoder and decoder with cross attention
tasks.test_task: encoder key-values are queried by decoder queries; heldout source-query pairings
guards: cross can only consume available encoder state
shared parameter does not imply free simultaneous compute
tasks.gate: preserved cross-source content dependence and no invalid dependency shortcut, then byte-matched heldout comparison

tasks.title: Exact canonical KV and multihead View read
tasks.gate: exact algebra and pointer share; performance separate from mechanism

tasks.title: FFN MoE roles with nonlinear View and private fallback
tasks.gate: show retained quality on independent/off-orbit functions with total code/router/runtime charges

tasks.title: Fused no-materialization runtime
tasks.gate: same-batch-hardware-precision and end-to-end tokens/sec better at matched quality; cold JIT separate

tasks.title: Arbitrary-precision scalar expansion at fixed m
tasks.gate: real increase in heldout useful function capacity per paid bit and acceptable bit-op runtime, not mere numerical distinguishability

study_protocol.development_selection: new development worlds only; do not tune on previously opened MA-1162 or MA-691 fresh
study_protocol.fresh: freeze >=3 independent worlds and >=2 independent init seeds before opening
required_resource_accounting: serialized bytes for all learned objects and codes
study_protocol.hardware: CPU container first, GPU only if actually available
study_protocol.historical_status_policy: do not edit or promote MA-1162/691/253/1163/1164 result verdicts from design-only progress
